question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We love to swing from the branches _______ the pond.
solution:
The correct answer is **Over**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options the correct option to be filled in the blank is **Over. **
 
• The word **"over"** is used to describe a movement or position that is superior to another.
 
• It can also be used while referring to movement across a surface.
